items.topic: Registry overview headline vs explicit field
items.evidence: Overview contains "Registered · Published"; machine registry_status active/Active, lifecycle published/Published.
items.followup: Do not parse headline as Registry Status; compare labeled fields with canonical machine values.

items.topic: Certifier date vs Registry source-certification date
items.followup: Date normalization is format-only; do not infer timestamp, timezone or current source validity.

items.topic: Source derivative versus Registry canonical object
items.evidence: SCRD record_type "SCRD" ID "SCRD-SC-CERT-2026-0001" vs SREG record_type "SREG" ID "SREG-2026-0001".
items.followup: Preserve different object identities, versions and authorities; derive explicit allowed source fields only.

items.topic: Certifier assessment detail and Registry historical assessment
items.evidence: SCRD assessment keys assessment_type, total_score, prototype_trust_level, confidence_posture, assessment_categories; SREG historical prototype assessment keys assessment_type, score, prototype_trust_level, status.
items.followup: Compare score, historical trust level and labels under owner-approved semantics; do not equate numerical prototype and certification class.

items.evidence: SCRD evidence_sources has 8 items; SREG does not expose an evidence_sources array at top level. Registry source_artifacts are a different concept.
items.followup: Confirm source evidence references and scope in canonical package and derivative; do not require Registry to replicate an entire Certifier evidence inventory absent Registry policy.

items.evidence: SCRD generated_artifacts has 5 keys; SREG source_artifacts has 5 keys.
items.followup: Compare artifact identities, URLs, canonical/derivative designations and version semantics individually; historical stubs cannot issue Registry objects.

items.evidence: SCRD governance keys: standards_version, methodology_version, applicable_standards, applicable_methodology_components; SREG governing_framework keys: suite_standards, suite_methodology.
items.followup: Verify standard/methodology versions and reference scope; no claim of mapping all governance fields.

items.evidence: SREG registry_validation contains 9 check entries; SCRD has no Registry validation section.
items.followup: Validate against Registry owner rules separately; a structural pass does not issue or publish SREG.

items.evidence: SREG registry_publication status "Published" and 2 published representation references; Certifier SCRD has no Registry publication section.
items.followup: Verify Registry HTML/JSON publication scope and actual served content before claiming current parity.

items.evidence: SREG lists 4 relationships, including native registers; SCRD is not the governing Registry relationship record.
items.followup: Check each direction, identifier domain, owner and authority; do not silently replace registers with Suite references.

items.evidence: SREG provenance contains 6 chain entries and 3 historical events.
items.followup: Field-level source-owner chronology, historical versions, corrections and no destructive edits require separate verification.

items.evidence: SREG includes schema_profile, maintenance keys correction_policy, versioning_policy, authority_preservation_policy and 7 notices.
items.followup: Check human Registry entry for policy references and complete field parity; not an issuer-owned attribute.

items.topic: Source identity and authority deeper fields
items.evidence: SCRD subject keys: subject_name, subject_system, subject_type, jurisdiction, primary_record; SREG registered_subject keys: subject_name, subject_system, subject_authority, subject_type, jurisdiction, subject_state_date, canonical_subject_url, authority_statement.
items.followup: Verify jurisdiction, subject state date, primary URL, subject type, Atlas authority; do not infer equivalence from name alone.

items.evidence: Canonical SREG HTML has detailed sections; Stage 3C checked field/text presence but not complete value-to-specific-DOM-label pairs. Source HTML also not a frozen wire payload.
items.followup: Perform owner-approved DOM-level field pairing or manually reviewed full field-by-field comparison; avoid reporting all fields as matching.
